answers.tech_stack.infrastructure: Local only, no cloud accounts, no managed services — reviewer clones and runs, nothing to provision
answers.workflow.tdd_strictness: Flexible — add tests where they make sense (parsing logic, edge cases like S-0011/S-0020), not mandated for every line.
answers.workflow.verification_checkpoints: After each phase completion — run all tests written so far, commit, then move on.
answers.workflow.code_review: Self-review via the verification step (CLAUDE.md §1) — solo project, no second reviewer.
answers.styleguides.existing_conventions: None found (no ruff/black/flake8/mypy config) — generate fresh guide.
answers.product.description: A CLI pipeline that ingests somatic VCF + sample manifest batches into a governed, queryable curated zone (bronze/silver/gold) for researchers and an eventual NL assistant.
answers.product.problem_statement: Somatic VCF + manifest batches arrive messy and change shape over time (schema drift, malformed files, referential gaps); researchers need to query them reliably, and a future NL assistant needs a foundation trustworthy enough to answer questions without a human sanity-checking its SQL.
answers.product.target_users: SQL-writing researchers today, and a natural-language assistant later that queries the same curated data.
answers.product.key_goals: Reliably queryable curated zone; reproducible re-runs; never silently drop or impute a record; additive schema evolution across batches.
answers.guidelines.voice_tone: Concise and direct, reasoning-forward — every claim backed by a command or a stated tradeoff, no filler.
answers.guidelines.design_principles: Never silently drop or impute; comprehensibility beats cleverness; schema evolution is additive only; every decision carries a written rationale.
